name: primitives-headless-switch
title: Headless Switch
description: A Connections card listing four options, each with a small pill switch; tapping one slides the thumb across and the thumb widens while held, with sun and moon icons on the theme row.
use: A settings list needs compact on/off toggles with a clear checked state.
avoid: It is renderless, so track, thumb and icon styling must all come from your own classes.
a11y: The switches carry no accessible name tied to their row titles, so screen readers announce a generic switch, and focus styling is absent. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark rounded card headed Connections with grey helper text and four rows, each with a bold title, a small grey description and a pill switch on the right. Switches are grey when off and white when on.
behaves: Clicking a switch moves its white thumb to the other end with a spring, and the thumb stretches wider while held before settling back. The theme switch swaps a moon on the left for a sun on the right.
customise: Children hold the thumb and optional icons; set defaultChecked or a controlled value plus a thumb pressedAnimation, while track and thumb styles come from your classes.
weight: light: Four small buttons with a moving thumb; nothing runs when idle.
demo: Rows for Airplane mode, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and Theme with short captions about wireless radios and networks.
issues: Off switches are a faint grey track on the dark card, so their state is easy to miss.
The switches are unlabelled, so their row titles are not announced with them.
polishWhy: Tidy settings rows and a tactile stretch; faint off states are the weak point.
